recipe.visualDefinition: A centered close-up portrait of a man with a 1970s hairstyle and polka-dot shirt, framed within a double-bordered rectangle on a heavily textured, mottled red background. The design features ornate gold-toned filigree borders and a mix of casual handwriting and formal script.
coreVisualRelationships: The portrait is the central focus, nested within multiple concentric frames.
The deep red textured background provides a high-contrast stage for the gold-toned borders and white text.
The casual white handwriting contrasts with the formal gold script at the bottom.
The polka-dot pattern of the shirt adds a secondary rhythmic texture within the central image.
coreInvariants: Mottled, leather-like red texture for the primary field.
Double-line gold border with an outer filigree pattern.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a head-and-shoulders portrait centered in the middle third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central portrait frame acts as the primary anchor, supported by the heavy red field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move up to the white handwriting, then down to the formal script at the bottom, finally circling the outer ornate border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the red textured field between the central frame and the outer edge.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (casual handwriting and highlights in the portrait).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red background with low value; high value in the text and borders for legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Thin, monolinear, casual cursive handwriting with high ascenders.
Bottom text: Formal, high-contrast copperplate-style script with flourished capitals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' in the top text has an oversized, looping top bowl.
The 'S' and 'A' in the bottom text feature elongated, elegant swashes.

composition.position: top center of the inner frame
composition.overlap: overlaps the top of the portrait

composition.position: bottom center of the red field

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between informal personal handwriting and formal institutional calligraphy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal script elegance of the bottom text.
Approximates the casual, monolinear feel of the top handwriting.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep crimson red background with a heavy mottled, leather-like texture. Add a central rectangular portrait of a man with 1970s hair and a polka-dot shirt. Surround the portrait with a thin gold double-line frame. Add an outer ornate gold filigree border near the edges of the canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white casual cursive handwriting overlapping the top of the portrait. Add a large, formal gold script title centered at the bottom of the red field.

verificationChecks: Is the red background sufficiently textured?
Are there two distinct styles of script?
Is the portrait centered and framed correctly?
Does the outer border have a filigree pattern?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red background texture
Color of the handwriting (white vs gold)
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the mottled red texture.
Ensure the gold script at the bottom is legible against the red.
Verify the white handwriting looks naturally integrated over the image.
Confirm the double-border framing is symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Mottled Red Field + Ornate Gold Border + Centered Portrait + (Casual Script Overlap + Formal Script Base)
